_contract: stitchu shared-value tables, K1 single contract (2026-07-19). Every number here used to live in 2+ places (the K0 double-truth inventory). Consumers NEVER copy these values: C++ reads engine/src/contract.gen.hpp, the web reads web/js/contract.gen.js, the backend reads backend/contract.gen.js (all three generated by engine/tools/gen-contract.mjs), the flat engine reads this file directly. docs/reference/dis-llm-panel-a.html is a FROZEN HISTORICAL artefact: its LEN {87,104,120} and SIZE tables are a museum piece from the external-LLM session, not a consumer, and are intentionally left untouched.

draft._layer: pattern-drafting truth. Real millimetres / centimetres on a real body. Binds the C++ engine. Changing a number here changes the golden reference; the golden diff is the guard.

gatherRatios._note: flat cut width / finished gathered width (FORMULAS.md, Drawstring / shirred / smocked gathering). The flat engine's per-style gatherRatio recipe values are DRAWING ink density, a different quantity; its real cut number (panelCutWidth) must derive from THESE ratios.

flat._layer: fashion-flat DRAWING units. 1 unit = 5.6 SVG px. NOT millimetres and NOT the same quantity as draft.*: flat.len.mini=42 is a stylised drawing length, draft.skirtLengthMM.mini=450 is a real hem drop. Both live in this one file so the same word never carries a third, undocumented number (the K0 1.1 finding: mini was 87, 42 and 450 in three engines).

derived.panelCutWidth: finished panel width x draft.gatherRatios[gatherType]. The flat engine derives its real cut number from the SAME ratio table the pattern engine cuts with; it never keeps a private ratio truth. Per-style recipe fields (styles.json gatherRatio, capPuff, ...) are ink/drawing knobs only.

style._layer: STYLE parameters (Damla 2026-07-19 decision, formerly review.* layer-undecided). These are flat-drawing taste knobs only; they shape the flat silhouette and have NO effect on pattern geometry (the drafting engine never reads them). Live in flat recipes (styles.json).

waistNip.note: waist suppression fraction of the flat silhouette

armholeHollow.note: armhole scoop fraction of the flat silhouette

mappings._layer: every cross-layer name/meaning translation, declared ONCE. Bridge code reads these; a translation that is not declared here is a contract violation (K0 findings 2.1-2.6).

sleeveHeadToSleeveCap._note: vision speaks sleeveHead {plain,gathered,puffed,capped}; the engine speaks sleeveCap {plain,gathered,puffed,cap}. Legacy aliases included so old cached specs still map.

nullEquivalence._note: fields where a null reading and this canonical value mean the SAME garment and draft identically. Was a private rule inside benchmark-58.mjs classify(); now contract data.

backDetailSplit._note: the vision's single backDetail field fans out to three targets in the bridge (K0 2.4). Declared here so the split is a contract, not a buried if-chain.

orphanFields._note: vision fields with no engine target, declared instead of silently dangling (K0 2.5).
orphanFields.straps.count: declared-unused (produced by vision, consumed nowhere; kept for future one-shoulder work)
orphanFields.fabricName: ui-only (photo fabric label on the result card; never reaches the engine)
orphanFields.cupSeams: honest (no engine capability; missing.js lists it for the user)

mappings.seenFlagsNote: sleeveCapDrawn = ANY non-plain sleeve head was drawn; capSleeveDrawn = specifically the cap WING. Similar names, different meanings (K0 2.6) — registered so the next bridge hand knows.
